[P3] Account for the rewritten test expectations

Rule 5.4 requires the description to list edited tests and their reasons. This replaces `test_an_input_that_is_not_json_raises_type_error`'s `TypeError`/no-operation expectations with `StepError`/recorded-operation expectations. The description explains the general behavior change but does not identify this edited test or inventory the other changed expectations. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and record the affected tests and rationale so the removed behavioral guarantees can be reviewed explicitly.
